strategy: 7d trailing funding rank, weekly rebalance, lowest 20% long/highest 20% short
source: Free official Binance Vision monthly fundingRate + 1h markPriceKlines
splits: chronological 50/20/30; fixed strategy; no OOS tuning
regime_definition: At each hourly/event timestamp, use trailing 30-day BTC mark-price return: bull > +5%, bear < -5%, otherwise sideways; no future data. Attribution is incremental PnL/cost by timestamp, not a separately rebalanced regime strategy.

assumptions.slippage: 2 bp one-way on rebalance turnover, in addition to 2/5/8 bp fee sensitivity
assumptions.maintenance_margin: static conservative 0.5% of stressed gross notional; historical symbol-specific Binance brackets unavailable in this public dataset
assumptions.intrabar: 1h mark-price OHLC; simultaneous adverse low for longs and high for shorts, conservative but not tick-accurate
assumptions.margin_mode: cross-portfolio approximation; funding cashflow at settlement; positions resized weekly
limitations: static MMR instead of historical symbol-specific tier brackets
hourly OHLC cannot reconstruct tick order or exact liquidation price
spread and market impact beyond fixed slippage are not modeled
